string-array.name: health_quotes
string-array.item: Small daily choices add up to big health changes.
Drinking enough water is one of the simplest gifts you can give your body.
Reading a food label takes ten seconds and can save you a bad reaction.
Your streak isn\'t about perfection — it\'s about showing up.
A short walk today is better than a perfect workout you never start.
Every meal is a chance to take care of yourself.
Progress, not perfection, is what keeps healthy habits alive.
The best diet is the one you can actually stick to.
Checking a label before you eat is an act of self-respect.
Consistency beats intensity when it comes to health.
